scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,agent -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @workspace/server" "npm run dev -w @workspace/client" "npm run dev:agent"
scripts.test: npm test -w @workspace/shared && npm test -w @workspace/server && npm test -w @workspace/agent && npm test -w @workspace/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p packages/agent
